evidence: Raises the required C++ standard to C++23 across CMakeLists.txt, depends, and CI, bumping toolchain minimums to GCC 13 and Clang 19.
rationale: Raises the C++ standard to C++23 to establish a new toolchain baseline and eliminate recurring workarounds. As the author notes, 'the workarounds to avoid C++23 keep accumulating and some parts of the code already use C++23 features', making this a strategic toolchain transition that unblocks downstream modernization like #34979.
